title: A quality expression selects a local comparison standard rather than an absolute degree
summary: Distinguish relative comparison to a neighboring property from an absolute degree label in the reusable quality/value frames.

design.mechanism: A quality/value construction evaluates a property relative to a locally supplied baseline or reference member; an absolute-degree construction names a fixed ordinal independent of that baseline.
design.unit: Complete quality-plus-value spans with independently bound baseline/reference and observed property contrast.
design.contrast: Relative comparison standard versus absolute ordinal degree, holding written value slot and quality head fixed.
design.prediction: Under relative semantics, the same value can reverse or change interpretation when the independently bound baseline changes; absolute semantics preserves the same degree across baselines.
design.falsifier: Held cases with changed baselines show invariant degree behavior where relative semantics predicts change, or no baseline-sensitive contrast can be independently bound.
design.scope: GDT627 quality/value frames; baseline and property endpoints availability_unknown.
design.related: Near IDEA000023 degree scope and GDT627/GDT630 quality-degree routes, but target is comparison standard, not modifier attachment or a new value lexeme.
design.countermodel: Renderer may normalize every value to a fixed ordinal while the neighboring property merely correlates with it.

source_evidence.quote:
GDT626 found a bounded four-cell ending but could only call it “value I–IV.”
GDT627 supplies the missing head semantics. The same written slot is reused
productively:

```text
quality head + a + value  = quality in degree I/II/III/IV
d            + a + value  = free measure or grade I/II/III/IV
```

In a plant-part list, the practical default for the second construction is a
local amount or dose. Thus `daiin` no longer means a generic operation and no
longer remains the opaque “d-value III.” It reads **three local measures or
portions**, with the kind of unit still open.

design.intake_limit: Raw proposal retained for later method review. Missing independently bound endpoints or identical model predictions are design/capacity stops, not empirical refutations. Source working glosses do not supply semantic gold.
